name: auto-router-companion
description: Status bar for auto-router (model, context %, quota) and automatic continuation in a new chat when the context is nearly full.

commands.title: auto-router: Continue in a new chat now

autoRouter.stateFile.description: Path to auto-router's data/context-state.json. Empty = read it from ~/.auto-router/config.json (written by `node ar.mjs init`).

autoRouter.autoNewChat.description: Open a new chat automatically when the gateway asks for it (context nearly full).

autoRouter.autoSend.description: Send the continuation prompt automatically (otherwise it is only typed into the chat box).
